patch_list: Log player URLs (debug)
Research aid, off by default: writes every URL the media player and the LuraPlayer SDK open to the device's local logcat (tag VIXURL). Nothing is sent anywhere.

sources.author: PatchLab
patch_list: Allow screenshots and screen recording
Removes Window FLAG_SECURE and prevents LuraPlayer SurfaceView from forcing secure mode. Note: hardware-backed Widevine L1 DRM video surfaces may still be blanked by Android.
Auto-skip server-side ads
Automatically calls LuraPlayer.skipAd() when an ad starts on non-live VOD streams.
Block player ads
Disables Lura client-side prerolls, pause ads, GAM pod-serve DAI configurations, clip ad tags, and Google IMA ad tag resolution in ViX players.
Bypass forced app update
Prevents SplashScreenFragment from displaying the blocking AppUpdateDialog.
Bypass OneTrust consent delay
Skips OneTrust CMP SDK initialization at startup and invokes the startup continuation immediately.
Disable telemetry and tracking
Disables NewRelic, Permutive, AppsFlyer attribution, Conviva/PAL player telemetry, advertising ID collection, and strips the AD_ID manifest permission.
Hide promotional popups
Suppresses Braze in-app promotional dialogs and upgrade banners.
Unlock Developer Tools
Bypasses the passcode gate for ViX's hidden Developer Tools menu. Tap the app version 6 times in Settings to open it.
